title: BetaClaudeTagSlackChannelBundleTarget
description: One Bundle attached to one Slack channel. The Bundle can be used in that channel only.

id.description: The Bundle Target's identifier. Starts with `btgt_`. No two Bundle Targets have the same one, and the same Bundle and target always give the same one, also after a detach and a new attach. It is opaque.

slack_channel_id.description: The identifier of the Slack channel the Bundle is attached to, starting with `slch_`. It is the channel object's `id`, not Slack's `channel_id`.
